question: Which port city is called the 'Queen of Arabian Sea'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kochi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kochi **was **the center **of the **Indian spice trade **for **many centuries.**
 
• It was **known **to the **Yavanas **(Greeks and Romans) as well as **Jews, Syrians, Arabs, and Chinese **since **ancient times**.
 
• **Accounts **by **Italian explorers Nicolo Conti **(15th century), and **Fra Paoline in the 17th century **say that it **was called Kochchi**.
 
• It is **named **after the **river connecting **the **backwaters to the sea**.
 
• After the arrival of the Portuguese, and **later the British**, the **name Cochin stuck **as the official appellation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marakkar IV **was at the forefront of **resistance **against the **Portuguese invaders **and is **regarded **as the **first naval commander **in **India **and was **also an expert navigator**. That is why they **have dubbed him the "lion of the Arabian Sea".**
 
• **Arabian Sea**:
 
 
• **Due mostly to its proximity **to the **Red Sea **and the **Persian Gulf**, the **Arabian Sea **is one of the **busiest maritime channels **in the world.
 
• **Large tankers**, the **majority **of which are **used for transportation **in the **Arabian Sea**, frequently end **their journeys **in **East Asia, Europe, or the Americas**.
